decision_threshold.metric: Qwen3.5-0.8B per-language score divided by its English score
decision_threshold.special_case: RU-only failure retains sub-1B with reduced Russian scope
decision_threshold.conservative_gap_resolution: An ES-only or FR-only failure moves to Q/F because the lane grants reduced scope only to RU.

notes: The native-language prompts are Codex-authored and machine-scored; no native-human validation is claimed.
The automated fluency quantity is explicitly a surface-language/script proxy, not proof of native fluency.
All eventual scores require an actual Colab run and will be labelled HOST with n printed.
